already_established.norm_conclusion: For token21/channel619, the observed and independently reconstructed original reduction order produces mean0x3b4ae0ec, two F32ULP below previously saved actual Torch variance0x3b4ae0ee. The native scale and two ordered multiply results match RN calculations for those observed inputs; an offline RN chain from saved Torch variance yields its saved0x3f568000 midpoint, while native yields0x3f568001. This reduction-order difference crosses the BF16 midpoint and explains this isolated coordinate and its already demonstrated propagation.

precision_mismatches.reference: Official rotary embedding forms F32 sin/cos, converts each to BF16, then applies BF16 products and BF16 addition to BF16 Q/K.

precision_mismatches.implication: Same rotation and input/output storage do not imply equal BF16 outputs. No evidence yet quantifies its contribution to final logits.
